body: The new feature in business class that high-end passengers are craving is sliding doors. First introduced over a decade ago, they let customers essentially shut themselves off from the rest of the cabin, and any airline offering a top business class seat generally needs to offer privacy doors today. JetBlue was the first airline to offer sliding doors in business class, present on four out of the 16 seats in the carrier's original 2014 Mint cabin, while Qatar Airways was the first airline to offer sliding doors at every seat with its QSuite in 2017, and Delta did the same later that same year with its Delta One Suite.

Qatar Airways leads the ranking with 119 aircraft equipped with business class suites: 90 aircraft with QSuites, including 15 A350-900s, all 30 A350-1000s, five of six 777-200LRs, and 40 of 57 777-300ERs, plus 29 787-9s with the Elevate Ascent suite. British Airways follows with 97 aircraft equipped with Club Suites, available on all 18 of its A350-1000s, all Heathrow-based 777s, all 787-8s, all 787-10s, and seven of its 18 787-9s, though its 12 A380s still feature the old Club World seats. Delta Air Lines ranks third with 81 aircraft offering Delta One Suites, on 41 A350-900s and 39 A330-900s.

Air France operates 45 aircraft with business class suites, including 23 A350-900s with the Stelia Opera WB and 22 retrofitted 777-300ERs with the Safran Versa, while KLM operates 32, China Eastern 28, and Lufthansa 28 Allegris aircraft. China Eastern offers sliding doors at every seat on its 20 A350-900s and eight 787-9s, whereas on Lufthansa's Allegris aircraft only the front-row Suite offers sliding doors. Qatar Airways plans to introduce QSuites Next Gen in 2027, originally meant to launch on the Boeing 777-9 but now likely to debut on the A350-1000 instead.
en.summary: Sliding privacy doors have become the must-have feature in business class, and seven airlines now operate the most aircraft equipped with them, led by Qatar Airways with 119, ahead of British Airways with 97 and Delta with 81.
en.title: Seven airlines with the most business class suites with closing doors in 2026

body: 高階旅客最渴望的商務艙新配備是滑動拉門。拉門問世已逾十年，能讓旅客幾乎與其餘客艙隔絕；如今任何主打頂級商務艙座椅的航空公司，基本上都必須提供隱私拉門。捷藍航空是最早在商務艙提供滑動拉門的航空公司，其2014年原始Mint客艙16個座位中有4個設有拉門；卡達航空則於2017年以QSuite率先在每個座位都提供滑動拉門，達美航空同年稍晚也以達美至臻商務艙套房跟進。

卡達航空以119架配備商務艙套房的飛機居首，其中90架配備QSuite，包括15架A350-900、全部30架A350-1000、6架777-200LR中的5架，以及57架777-300ER中的40架，另有29架787-9配備Elevate Ascent套房。英國航空以97架居次，Club Suites見於全部18架A350-1000、所有以希斯洛為基地的777、全部787-8、全部787-10，以及18架787-9中的7架，但其12架A380仍使用舊款Club World座椅。達美航空以81架排名第三，達美至臻商務艙套房見於41架A350-900與39架A330-900。

法國航空擁有45架商務艙套房飛機，包括23架配備Stelia Opera WB的A350-900與22架換裝Safran Versa的777-300ER；荷蘭航空32架、中國東方航空28架、漢莎航空28架Allegris飛機。中國東方航空在其20架A350-900與8架787-9的每個座位都提供滑動拉門；漢莎航空Allegris客艙中則只有前排套房設有滑動拉門。卡達航空計畫於2027年推出新世代QSuite，原定搭載於波音777-9，但因777X計畫延誤，現在可能改由A350-1000率先搭載。
zh.summary: 滑動拉門已成為高階商務艙的必備配備；目前擁有最多拉門商務艙套房機隊的7家航空公司中，卡達航空以119架居首，英國航空97架、達美航空81架分居二、三名。
zh.title: 2026年擁有最多商務艙拉門套房的7家航空公司
